page.overview:
Who is Fish Devil?

The is a Devil who embodies the concept of fish.

Fish Devil has the appearance of a giant fish, with twin tails at its back end. Its only other distinguishing feature is its set of 6 seemingly bio-mechanical legs.

Nothing is currently known about the Fish Devil's personality except it presumably possesses hatred for humans like all non-humanoid devils.

At some point, Fish Devil had eaten a chunk of the Gun Devil's flesh.
